workloads.live: 100 genuine ECS objects; initial tick one; original 250 ms schedule

instrumentation.cpu: exact monotonic U64 clocks; available/unavailable metrics
instrumentation.gpu: two timestamps per completed command buffer; reset plus TOP before barriers and BOTTOM after present transition; read before command reset

statistics.gpu_raw: raw U64 counter limbs, availability, valid bits, F32 period and duration bits, independent CPU completion bound
statistics.gpu_summary: F32 duration truncated to integer nanoseconds
statistics.median: middle order statistic, midpoint for even count
statistics.repeat_range: median and min/max of the five repeat medians; no pooled primary comparison
